current.assumptions: Conditional injury-response and concession-workforce channels, plus a separate completed-therapy hypothesis, not whole SOL portfolio. Injury risk, one exposed person per incident, QALY magnitude and job additionality/net resources are judgments. Pilot hospital RCT did not establish a significant effect; all exposures retain negative costs and harms.

why: Added measured completed-therapy cohort as a separate explicitly judged finite health channel, with full access burdens and tested injury/job overlap; this is scope refinement rather than empirical portfolio calibration.
